content: BullMQ remains the standard Redis-backed Node.js job queue (14M+ monthly downloads) with priorities, delayed jobs, rate limiting, and repeatable jobs. Since BullMQ v3, group-key rate limiting was removed from OSS (only in paid BullMQ Pro); OSS rate limiting is per-worker/per-queue (token bucket), not per-tenant-group. Standard workaround for per-tenant RPS: separate queues per priority class (triggered vs broadcast) plus an application-level per-tenant token bucket (e.g. rate-limiter-flexible backed by Redis) gating dispatch before calling SendGrid, rather than relying on BullMQ's built-in limiter. pg-boss is a viable Postgres-only alternative but caps around 100-200 jobs/sec due to lock contention -- insufficient at target scale.
